articles.title: India’s CoinDCX Confirms $16 Million Loss Days After CEO Called It a ‘False Alarm’
articles.description: The Mumbai-based exchange says 15.99 million USDT was drained from wallets it retired after last year’s $44 million hack, bringing its combined losses to nearly $60 million—and it’s absorbing the hit.

articles.title: Brazil’s Stock Market Crashes After Lula’s Upset Victory
articles.description: The iShares Brazil ETF fell as much as 26% after Lula da Silva beat Flávio Bolsonaro, who prediction markets had at 80%, while the dollar jumped as much as 12% against the real.

articles.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine Keeps Buying Ethereum But Pivots to Record Share Buybacks
articles.description: The firm added 10,452 ETH to reach 4.95% of supply, but its bigger move was repurchasing 2.04 million of its own shares—part of what it calls the largest equity buyback any crypto treasury company has run.

articles.title: 'Privacy Horror’: Researcher Uncovers Extent of Samsung Smart TV User Tracking
articles.description: AI-powered reverse engineering could make it "easier and faster" for researchers to uncover and explain how devices collect and share data.

articles.title: Anthropic Makes IPO Filing Public, Plans Nasdaq Listing Under ‘ANT’
articles.description: The S-1 shows revenue up from $1.2 billion a year earlier, and a share structure that leaves a trust and the co-founders in control.

articles.title: Strategy Pauses Bitcoin Buying, Spends $205M Buying Back STRC
articles.description: The Bitcoin treasury firm's USD Cash balance fell to $242.4 million after its biggest weekly STRC buyback in more than a month.

articles.title: Bitcoin Dips Below $80,000 Ahead of Fed Decision, Midterms
articles.description: Analysts point to a sell-off in AI stocks and ETF outflows, with HashKey's Tim Sun flagging $75,000 as the next key support level.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s Bear Market Is Over, Galaxy Research Says: 'Now Is an Attractive Time to Buy'
articles.description: Galaxy Research says Bitcoin’s bear market ended in June, pointing to a reclaimed 50-week moving average, fading selling pressure, and a strengthening debasement case.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Bitcoin Breaks Below $80,000 as Iran Fears Hit the Weekend
articles.description: Some relief is appearing this morning as oil and rates fall, with a big macro week ahead featuring major earnings, FOMC and key data drops.

articles.title: Israel's Central Bank Rebukes Netanyahu Plan to Use Crypto to Dodge Sanctions
articles.description: Over 100 economists, including former governor Jacob Frenkel, warned of deeper isolation ahead of Israel's October 27 national election.

articles.title: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Intuit Among 6 More Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks
articles.description: Twenty-two companies have now objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, after Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell, Arm, Moderna. and Intuit joined the list.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs Snap Two-Week Losing Streak Despite Late-Week Slide
articles.description: Spot Bitcoin ETFs finished the week with about $301 million in net inflows, ending a two-week losing streak, even as two straight days of outflows kept October in the red.

articles.title: Google Quietly Updates Privacy Policy to Let Gmail and Photos Data Feed Ads
articles.description: A policy change effective Oct. 16 carves out an exception to Google’s long-standing pledge—letting connected Gmail, Drive, and Photos data personalize ads through its Personal Intelligence AI features.

articles.title: Sweden's Government Offices Block ChatGPT and Claude, Keep Microsoft Copilot
articles.description: Sweden's Government Offices will block ChatGPT and Claude on staff computers from Monday, steering civil servants to Microsoft Copilot as the only AI that passed its security review.

articles.title: Game Publishers Have Pushed to Cut Discs Since 2007, Infinity Ward Veteran Says
articles.description: Robert Bowling, who spent six years working on Call of Duty, told Decrypt that Activision suggested cutting discs nearly two decades ago.

articles.title: Hong Kong’s Biggest Bank Puts a Stablecoin in 3 Million Wallets
articles.description: HSBC switched on its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin inside PayMe on Friday, testing whether a bank-issued token can become everyday money.

articles.title: Netanyahu Considering Crypto Plan to Dodge Banking Sanctions on Israel
articles.description: Days before Israel’s election, Netanyahu said he has asked for a blockchain plan in case banks are hit with sanctions, and told Israelis to prepare for a rainy day after Trump.

articles.title: Senate Democrat Probes Tether Payments to Ex-White House Crypto Adviser’s Firm
articles.description: Sen. Richard Blumenthal demanded Tether’s records on payments to Nxum, a firm co-owned by former White House crypto adviser Bo Hines.

articles.title: SpaceX Filing Gives Elon Musk the Final Word on Tesla Merger He Says He’s Staying Out Of
articles.description: SpaceX’s latest 10-Q filing quietly confirms any Tesla combination requires sign-off from its “controlling shareholder.”

articles.title: SEC Flags AI 'Super Intelligence' and Tokenization as Systemic Market Risks
articles.description: The regulator's Division of Examinations named "super intelligence and other advanced technologies" as a focus area alongside tokenization risks.

articles.title: How I Vibe Coded My Smart TV—And Claude Killed It
articles.description: Vibe coding your TV is impressive. Doing it without knowing exactly what you're touching is how you lose a rooted LG set and get a very sincere apology from an AI.

articles.title: Bitcoin Core Rewrites Its Security Policy for a World Where AI Finds Bugs in One Prompt
articles.description: Developers will now backport fixes and cut releases immediately for flaws flagged as “easily discoverable,” abandoning long embargoes for bugs an attacker can surface with a single AI prompt.

articles.title: Crypto Scammers Who Used Prayer Groups to Lure Victims Must Pay $1.3 Billion, Says New York
articles.description: New York’s attorney general asked a court to order NovaTech’s founders, who fled the country, to pay about $1.37 billion, and settled with four top promoters for nearly $6 million.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $636 Million as October Turns Red Again
articles.description: Spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $635.6 million on Thursday, their biggest outflow of the month, pushing October flows back to a loss of about $176 million as Ethereum and Solana funds also bled.

articles.title: Morning Minute: a16z Drops 'Crypto' From Its Fund
articles.description: The name change is symbolic of the fund’s future investing focus, though the firm will continue investing in crypto.

articles.title: Interpol Recovers $105M in African Cybercrime Sweep That Shut Illegal Crypto Mines
articles.description: Operation Serengeti III led to 1,462 arrests across 21 countries, while Angolan police seized more than 2,000 crypto mining devices.

articles.title: Ethereum Delays Glamsterdam Testnet Fork Over Gas Security Flaws
articles.description: The Hoodi testnet fork is off after ChainSecurity found gas changes that could let contracts lock in failures, citing 13 real-world cases.

articles.title: Heatbit's $899 Water Heater Element Mines Bitcoin While It Heats Your Tank
articles.description: The Bitwater element swaps a tank's resistance wire for 20 mining chips, and Heatbit says it uses the same electricity to heat the water.

articles.title: Bitcoin in 'Wait and See Mode'—And That Might Be a Good Thing
articles.description: The crypto market has been quiet as of late. Market analysts think that might actually be a good sign and that a bull market might be near.

articles.title: Is the Internet Safe Again After the PHP Nightmare? What You Need to Know
articles.description: PHP shipped its fix, attackers launched millions of attempts, and governments say no one has broken in yet. Here's what that means for your passwords, your crypto, and your browsing.

articles.title: ChatGPT Teaches Messi Chess—On a Board It Set Up Wrong, With an Opening That Loses in Four Moves
articles.description: Lionel Messi’s ChatGPT ad has the AI teaching him chess on a board with kings and queens swapped, then suggesting an opening that loses in four moves on that board.

articles.title: a16z Drops Crypto From Its Name, Widens Bets to AI and Frontier Tech
articles.description: Andreessen Horowitz is renaming its crypto fund a16z Frontier and widening its scope to AI, autonomous machines and biology, saying the line between crypto and everyday tech has blurred.

articles.title: Meta Creates Non-Voting Stock to Fund AI Buildout, Keeping Zuckerberg in Control
articles.description: Meta will hand shareholders a free non-voting share for every share they own in January, giving it a way to raise equity for AI spending without diluting Zuckerberg's 60.6% vote.

articles.title: Coinbase Fined Again in Ireland, This Time $3.6M Over Fund Safeguarding
articles.description: The Central Bank of Ireland penalized Coinbase Ireland €3,252,618 for leaning too heavily on its U.S. parent and leaving its safeguarding account underfunded—its second hit to the exchange’s European arm in the last year.

articles.title: Tesla's Profit Drops 43% as Musk Starts Building Robots and Plans to Sell Driverless Cabs
articles.description: Tesla earned $787 million last quarter, down from $1.37 billion, as spending on robots and self-driving cars soared. Optimus is in production, and Tesla aims to get Cybercabs to customers by year-end.

articles.title: Oil Climbs Above $111 as AI Stocks Slide, Dragging the S&P 500 and Global Markets With Them
articles.description: Brent crude hit a five-month high while Nvidia, Meta and chip stocks fell, pulling Asia's benchmark indexes down by up to 3.5% a week after South Korea's Kospi plunged 7.57%.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs Erase October Losses With $1 Billion in Three Days
articles.description: Spot Bitcoin ETFs have drawn about $1.07 billion over three sessions, pushing October flows to a gain of roughly $460 million, even as Bitcoin and Ethereum prices slipped.

articles.title: What Is a Neocloud? The GPU Clouds Powering the AI Boom
articles.description: Neoclouds like CoreWeave and Nebius rent Nvidia GPUs to AI labs, and several started out mining crypto. Here's how the AI cloud model works.

articles.title: Major Banks Find Rogue AI Agents Inside Customer Accounts—And They’re 'Horrified'
articles.description: Major banks including Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Bank of America, and Citi are moving to restrict third-party AI agents that log in with customers’ credentials.

articles.title: Trade Where You Read: Decrypt Brings Jupiter-Powered Trading to The Information Exchange
articles.description: Decrypt is building a destination where readers can discover, understand and trade the news, directly where they consume information.
